annotations.title: Submit a drafted sighting report (step 2 of 2)

description: Step 2 of 2: send a draft prepared by draft_sighting_report to the Vigi-Sky Witness station and notify the team. Call it only after showing the summary and getting the witness's explicit agreement in the conversation. Publishes first name (or 'Anonyme'), town, date, description and position rounded to about 1 km; the email is never published. One submission per draft; at most 3 per client per day and 30 per day overall.
name: submit_sighting_report

outputSchema.description: Returns status (executed), observation_id, suite; or erreur with statut a_verifier when the transmission is uncertain (do not resend).
